question.problem: A thin plate $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=4y$ is enclosed between the line $x=y$ and the $y$-axis for $1\le y\le 2.$ Find the moment of the plate about the $y$-axis.
question.worked_solution:
The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $y$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{y}={∬}_{D}x\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $D$ is a type II plane region, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14121640/assets/f8454539cbe01d45842ab03386e06bbbdca35d400d0e214563843d99cddd5a85.png)

So, we have 

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le y,\,1\le y\le 2}
$$

and $\lambda (x,y)=4y.$ 

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{y} & ={∬}_{D}x\cdot 4y\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}4xy\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}4xy\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}2y[{\int }_{0}^{y}2x\text{d}x]\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}2y[{x}^{2}]_{x=0}^{x=y}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}2y({y}^{2}-0)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}2{y}^{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[\frac{{y}^{4}}{2}]}_{y=1}^{y=2} \\  & =8-\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{15}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
